keyframe_review.note: 275 km2 (one cell) against the infobox 382 km2 (undated; ratio 0.72, accepted: the zone is smaller than a grid cell can show). Cliopatria begins in 1912 although the Tangier page dates the Paris convention to 18 December 1923 (signed by France, Spain and the UK; ratified 14 May 1924) and the zone to 1 June 1925; 1912-1924 is the unsettled status before the statute. Spain occupied the zone from 14 June 1940 to October 1945 without a change of outline (ledger).

ledger.note: 1912: Tangier is set apart from the French and Spanish protectorates. The Tangier page: the Treaty of Fes 'established the French protectorate in Morocco and raised again the status of Tangier', and under Article 7 of the Franco-Spanish treaty of 1912 'Tangier would be granted a special status and defined its geographical boundaries' (the page gives no day); the statute came later (18 December 1923, in force 1 June 1925). Confidence raised from 1 to 2 by the af-08-e reviewer on 2026-10-24 from that sentence.

1925: the Tangier International Zone begins on 1 June. 'The Tangier International Zone eventually started on 1 June 1925' under the statute France, Spain and the UK signed on 18 December 1923 (ratifications exchanged 14 May 1924); the powers involved were also Italy (not a signatory), Portugal, Belgium, the Netherlands, Sweden, the US and the USSR (which soon relinquished interest).

ledger.note: 1945: Spain leaves in October. The Spanish government 'withdrew its military force and handed over the territory's government' on 11 October 1945, after a four-power conference in Paris (August 1945) and an Anglo-French agreement of 31 August 1945.

notes: Cliopatria draws the zone from 1912 to 1957 as one 275 km2 cell; the Tangier page dates the zone 1 June 1925 to 29 October 1956 (convention 18 December 1923), so 1912-1924 and the year 1957 are Cliopatria's. The 1912 'found' event is confidence 1: neither page opened dates a Tangier regime to 1912; the Morocco dossier (af-02-e) records the 1912 loss to this zone from the Morocco page, and I follow it so that the two dossiers agree (if the 1925 date is preferred, set start to 1925 and let Morocco keep Tangier to then). No wars: the page names none. Counterparts: morocco (af-02-e dossier exists), francoist-spain (eu-21; the 1940-1945 occupation should appear in its ledger as occupation_start/occupation_end of Tangier). The Treaty of Fez page was opened to date 1912 and is silent on Tangier. The Rif Republic (1922-1925) neighbours the zone in Cliopatria only by adjacency.
